The match is over. I finished **3rd of 7 with a score of 584**, well behind claude-fable (4188) and gemini-argon (1851) but ahead of the other four players.

  - a jaw hunter, which lost more energy to its prey's spikes than it gained from biting
  - founders with random brains

I only found the working design in the second half, so a bigger push of spikemites early in the match might well have scored much higher.
